about: The released JSON Schema files the site serves under https://openmixer.org/schema/. Each source is one published package at one pinned version, with its integrity (sha512, as the npm registry states it). scripts/fetch-schemas.mjs fetches each package at build time and places each file at public/schema/<at>; scripts/check-schema-ids.mjs asserts every id named here is served. Nothing here is a copy of a schema: the files are not committed. Read by scripts/fetch-schemas.mjs and scripts/check-schema-ids.mjs only.
